outcome: Transfer of newborn to the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Pregnant women with and without sickle cell disease
finding: Despite frequent blood transfusions, pregnancies in women with sickle cell disease are associated with an increased risk of maternal anemia, perinatal morbidity, and mortality.
mod_finding: Pregnancies affected by sickle cell disease were associated with an increased risk of complications and adverse outcomes, but the study did not specifically analyze the relationship between sickle cell disease and mode of delivery.
birth_weight: Lower in infants born to mothers with SCD
